title: Admit larger host-authored plans atomically without the agent receipt ceiling
outcome: Admit larger host-authored plans atomically without the agent receipt ceiling
acceptance: A host plan substantially larger than 16 tasks commits its complete graph and key mapping atomically under explicit independent operator limits
Boundary and oversized requests refuse without a partial graph; exact retry after restart returns the original complete mapping without new writes
CLI process coverage and documentation agree on input, receipt, and graph limits
Large-plan validation has measured cost and regression coverage, and ordinary agent response budgets stay unchanged

completion.summary: Delivered atomic host plans up to256 tasks and1024 edges with1MiB typed input,2MiB raw reader and complete64KiB result, preserving129-task per-tree and agent limits. Exact restart retry, whole-store refusal rollback and bounded validation cost covered. All nine corrected gates pass; pair and scoped corrections accepted with independently matching final freeze. Source ready; not committed or installed.
